Product variants Default Title - $138.99 Quantity Decrease quantity for Animals Pedal ANGEL BEAR FACE FUZZ Increase quantity for Animals Pedal ANGEL BEAR FACE FUZZ Add to cart     #FUZZ , #PEDAL , Couldn't load pickup availability Refresh Share Share Link Close share Copy link Welcome to the Animals Pedal Angel Bear Face Fuzz, a unique fuzz pedal created in collaboration with Skreddy Pedals. Inspired by the classic fuzz tones from the 1960s, the Angel Bear Face Fuzz combines vintage charm with modern versatility, giving guitarists a broad range of expressive tones. Whether you're after thick, gritty fuzz or sparkling cleans, this pedal adapts to your playing style. Features & Overview Vintage-inspired Fuzz: Based on the iconic Fuzz Face design from the 1960s, using silicon transistors for a rich, powerful sound. Simple yet Versatile Controls: Easily dial in your tone with intuitive controls for LEVEL, FUZZ, and a BRIGHT/JUICY switch for tone shaping. True Bypass: Ensures a clean, uncolored signal when the pedal is off. Powered by 9V Battery or Adapter: Convenient power options for any setup. Getting Started 1. Connect your guitar to the input jack and your amp to the output jack. 2. Power up the pedal using either a 9V battery or a standard center-negative 9V adapter. 3. Adjust the controls: - Set the FUZZ knob to maximum for classic fuzz tones. - Use the LEVEL knob to adjust the overall volume. - Experiment with your guitar's volume control to access cleaner tones. Tone Shaping with the Bright/Juicy Switch - BRIGHT mode: Produces a sharper, clearer tone. Great for cutting through a mix. - JUICY mode: Adds thickness and warmth to the fuzz, giving a more saturated sound. Control Overview - LEVEL : Adjusts the output volume of the pedal. - FUZZ : Controls the amount of fuzz/distortion. Start with it maxed out for classic fuzz tones and roll back as needed. - BRIGHT/JUICY : Toggles between two fuzz textures—sharper in BRIGHT mode and thicker in JUICY mode. Power Options - 9V Battery: Insert a 9V battery inside the pedal. Be sure to unplug the input jack when not in use to preserve battery life. - 9V DC Adapter*: Use a standard center-negative DC 9V adapter for continuous power. Pro Tips - Use your guitar's volume knob : One of the most distinctive features of this fuzz pedal is its ability to clean up beautifully when you lower your guitar's volume knob, offering you more control and tonal variety. - Max the FUZZ knob : For the richest, fullest sound, start with the FUZZ knob at its maximum setting. - Switch between modes : Experiment with the BRIGHT and JUICY modes to find the right balance for your sound.
